synth.notes:
Crane: A1/A2 move ring+beam y-/+6, carry on-beam blocks, chain-push blocks hit; cancel whole move if a block leaves y[2,58] (step 56: blocks would reach y=1).
A4/A3 change beam w by +/-6 within [1,43]. A hooked next/collected block (x == tip-4) drags every on-beam block. Otherwise extending pushes next/collected blocks in the swept columns.
If a moved group would pass x>48 or enter the ring, it stays put and the beam changes alone. Step 128: collected block_12 is hooked and drags the group, block_9 would reach 54, so the beam goes to 43 alone.
Tags: a hooked next becomes collected when every OTHER on-beam block is collected (not only when it is alone); then the rightmost todo becomes next. With no hook, a collected block off the beam reverts to next.
Unconfirmed: ring y bound [0,58]; which collected block reverts when several are off the beam (largest x chosen); chain pushes of todo blocks during extension.
